reason: arena-table-cell draws a cell box -- the padding, the alignment and the mono/gold treatment its column asks for, or in card mode a label/value pair or a full-width block -- and projects whatever the consumer put in it. It manages no state and owns no interactive element of its own: any ArenaBadge, ArenaButton or link inside is caller-supplied content. What it DOES carry is not its own affordance either: the cell role comes from the <td> it is, and the roving tabindex and the focus ring belong to the enclosing grid arena-table binds, which it reads from the shared state rather than declaring. In card mode it declares role="presentation", which is not an affordance either but the removal of one: below the breakpoint the box is a label beside a value and not a cell of anything.
